title: Balapokuna Raja Maha Vihara
displaytitle: Balapokuna Raja Maha Vihara

titles.display: Balapokuna Raja Maha Vihara

description: Buddhist temple in Colombo District, Sri Lanka
extract: Balapokuna Raja Maha Vihara is a historic Buddhist temple situated in Pamankada, Western Province, Sri Lanka. It is located near to the 6th mile post junction on Colombo-Batticaloa main road. The temple has been formally recognised by the Government as an archaeological site in Sri Lanka. The designation was declared on 6 June 2008 under the government Gazette number 1553. As part of the name of several temples, Raja Maha Vihara means in English: Great Royal Temple or Great Royal Monastery. It designates ancient Sri Lankan Buddhist temples that historically received royal patronage and donations from the king.
